LanguageData.Raven_Ability_ForceLovin.label: (Raven) Force Lovin'
LanguageData.Raven_Ability_ForceLovin.description: Using the Raven race's charm or intimidation, forces a member of the opposite sex to engage in lovin' immediately.\n\n(If enabled in the mod settings, this can be cast on walls; with the Chisel-Chisel-Chisel, it can be cast on natural ore veins.)
